newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BESI SEES IMPROVEMENT RESULTS H2 VS H1.
newsitem.headline: BESI SEES IMPROVEMENT RESULTS H2 VS H1.

text.p: BE Semiconductors Industries NV (BESI) said on Tuesday it expected a strong improvement in its results during the second half of 1997 compared to the first half.
"The second half of the year will be better, substantially better, than the first half of the year," BESI president Richard Blickman said in a conference call.
Net profit was 4.1 million guilders during the first quarter and 4.8 million during the second.
"During the third quarter we do not expect a big impact from the improvement in orders, so we see the strongest contribution from the fourth quarter," he said.
"The fourth quarter will be significantly better than the second quarter," Blickman added. "There is also a chance that the fourth quarter of 1997 will be better than the fourth quarter last year."
Net profits for the whole of 1996 were 37.8 million guilders. In the first half of 1996 BESI's net was 23.8 million guilders and in the third quarter 6.7 million guilders.
He declined to give a precise forecast for growth in profits and turnover in the second half of 1997 and the year as a whole.
